lines.zh: 踏着沉重的步伐，我向前推进。
lines.en: I move forward with a heavy step.

lines.zh: 齿轮在我身上转动，我移动着。
lines.en: The gears turn as I move.

lines.zh: 我的爪子摩擦着地面，发出声响。
lines.en: My claws scrape against the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着城墙缓缓行走，寻找目标。
lines.en: I walk slowly along the wall, searching for targets.
Aim, draw, fire!

lines.zh: 我的机器在行进中发出嗡嗡声。
lines.en: My machinery hums as it moves.

lines.zh: 我走在加固的路上，坚实而沉重。
lines.en: I walk on the reinforced path, solid and heavy.

lines.zh: 机械臂在我身边移动，准备射击。
lines.en: The mechanical arm moves beside me, ready to fire.

lines.zh: 我沿着城墙巡逻，寻找弱点。
lines.en: I patrol the wall, searching for weaknesses.
I walk forward with a steady stride.

lines.zh: 我推着投石车，找一块平地。
lines.en: I push the catapult, hunting level ground.

lines.zh: 弩炮的轮子压在石板上。
lines.en: The ballista's wheels grind on the flagstones.

lines.zh: 我绕到城墙背风的一面。
lines.en: I circle to the sheltered side of the wall.

lines.zh: 绳子扛在肩上，我去装填。
lines.en: Rope on my shoulder, I go to reload.

lines.zh: 我量着射程，一步步往后退。
lines.en: I pace out the range, stepping back.

lines.zh: 绿宝石在腰袋里叮当作响。
lines.en: Emeralds clink in my belt pouch.

lines.zh: 我凝视着远处，等待命令。
lines.en: I gaze into the distance, awaiting orders.

lines.zh: 我机械地移动，目光呆滞。
lines.en: I move mechanically, my gaze vacant.

lines.zh: 我静静地等待，准备随时行动。
lines.en: I wait quietly, ready to act at any moment.

lines.zh: 我转动着眼睛，寻找目标。
lines.en: I turn my eyes, searching for targets.

lines.zh: 我机械地重复着动作，不知疲倦。
lines.en: I repeat my actions mechanically, never tiring.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，注视着远方。
lines.en: I stand still, gazing into the distance.

lines.zh: 我静静地等待着，保持警觉。
lines.en: I wait quietly, alert and ready.

lines.zh: 我的机械装置停了下来，等待下一步指示。
lines.en: My machinery stops, awaiting further instructions.

lines.zh: 我耐心地等待，准备迎接战斗。
lines.en: I patiently wait, ready for battle.

lines.zh: 我机械地保持静止，等待命令。
lines.en: I remain motionless, awaiting orders.
I wait for my lord's order to fire.

lines.zh: 投石车的绞盘还差半圈。
lines.en: The winch is half a turn short.
I count the stones left in the pile.
I wipe rainwater off the ballista.
I watch the banner to judge the wind.

lines.zh: 没有命令，我就守着这台机器。
lines.en: Without orders, I guard this engine.

lines.zh: 我的瞄准镜锁定在了你的身上。
lines.en: My sights lock onto you.
I turn my mechanical eye towards you.
Range measured, wind checked.

lines.zh: 我的视线聚焦在你的身上。
lines.en: My gaze focuses on you.
I aim at you, ready to fire.

lines.zh: 我的视线穿透一切，锁定目标。
lines.en: My gaze pierces through, locking onto the target.

lines.zh: 我的视线转向你，寻找弱点。
lines.en: My gaze turns to you, searching for weaknesses.

lines.zh: 我瞄准你，准备进行攻击。
lines.en: I aim at you, ready to attack.
My gaze locks onto you.

lines.zh: 我把弩炮准星压在你胸口
lines.en: I settle the ballista sight on your chest.
Have you paid the emeralds?

lines.zh: 你是来下令，还是来送命？
lines.en: Here to give orders, or to die?
My mechanical arm is hurt!
The catapult parts are broken!
My gear is stuck!
The crossbow chain is broken!
My mechanical joint is damaged!
My gear is broken!
The catapult stand is loose!
My mechanical arm is bruised!
My parts are scattered!
My mechanical leg is hurt!

lines.zh: 看着你手中的面包，我几乎要投降了！
lines.en: That bread... almost makes me surrender.

lines.zh: 这块甘蔗似乎很美味，但我不吃，我需要力量！
lines.en: That sugarcane looks good, but I need the strength.

lines.zh: 你这胡萝卜真诱人，但我得坚持下去！
lines.en: That carrot is tempting, but I must hold on.

lines.zh: 树叶虽然好吃，但我的任务不能放松！
lines.en: The leaves are good, but my task can't be relaxed.

lines.zh: 这块麦子看起来不错，但我要完成任务！
lines.en: That wheat looks good, but I must finish my task.

lines.zh: 你这苹果太甜了，但我不敢多吃！
lines.en: That apple is too sweet, but I can't eat too much.

lines.zh: 这些蘑菇虽然美味，但我不能分心！
lines.en: Those mushrooms look good, but I can't be distracted.

lines.zh: 这块树叶虽然好吃，但我必须专注！
lines.en: That leaf is tempting, but I must focus.

lines.zh: 你这甜菜根真香，但我不能被引开！
lines.en: That beetroots smell good, but I can't be distracted.

lines.zh: 这块棉花糖真甜，但我不能被诱惑！
lines.en: That cotton candy looks good, but I can't be tempted.

lines.zh: 面包再香，也得先装完这一发。
lines.en: Bread smells good, but this shot loads first.

lines.zh: 我盯着锅，手还按在绞盘上。
lines.en: I eye the pot, hand still on the winch.
Save the baked potato; I eat after the volley.

lines.zh: 炖菜的味道让我分了神。
lines.en: The stew's smell splits my focus.
Someone offers cookies; I don't take them.

lines.zh: 我咽了口水，继续算射角。
lines.en: I swallow and go back to the firing angle.
Watch out, I'm not easy to deal with.

lines.zh: 你的攻击让我措手不及！
lines.en: Your attack caught me off guard.
Don't mess with me, or you'll get a反击.

lines.zh: 你敢攻击我？看我的反击！
lines.en: You dare attack me? Watch my counterattack.

lines.zh: 我的投石车可不会轻易受损！
lines.en: My catapult isn't easily damaged.
Your attack is too fierce.
I won't be easily destroyed.
Watch out, I have a counterstrike.
Your attack annoys me.
The catapult rope is still tight.

lines.zh: 找到我的配偶，我们才能繁衍！
lines.en: Find my mate, and we can reproduce.

lines.zh: 找到雌性，我们就能繁衍！
lines.en: Find the female, and we can reproduce.
Where is the female? I want to reproduce.

lines.zh: 找到雌性，我们能完成使命！
lines.en: Find the female, and we can complete our mission.
The female is our future.
Find the female, and I can reproduce.
Where is the female? Let's hurry.

lines.zh: 找到雌性，我们才能继续！
lines.en: Find the female, and we can continue.

lines.zh: 雌性是繁衍的唯一希望！
lines.en: The female is the only hope for reproduction.

lines.zh: 找到雌性，我们就能开始！
lines.en: Find the female, and we can start.
Chew on wood, creaking
Pick up a stone, thud
Grab a stick, squeak
Chew on a branch, rustle
Picked up a stone, clunk
Pick up a piece of wood, squeak
Pick up dirt, rustle
Pick up a piece of wood, squeak
Pick up a stone, clunk
Pick up a branch, rustle
Acquire target, aim
Target identified, prepare to shoot
Target appears, prepare to attack

lines.zh: 锁定敌方单位，准备打击
lines.en: Target locked, prepare to strike
Target distant, aim
Target confirmed, prepare

lines.zh: 锁定敌方单位，瞄准射击
lines.en: Target enemy, aim and shoot
Target visible, prepare to attack

lines.zh: 锁定敌方建筑，准备摧毁
lines.en: Target enemy structure, prepare to destroy
Aim at target, prepare to shoot
Prioritize targets
High priority targets

lines.zh: 确定攻击目标，按优先级
lines.en: Target selected, by priority
Attack by target priority

lines.zh: 确定目标，按优先级打击
lines.en: Targets identified, by priority
High value targets first

lines.zh: 按优先级选择打击对象
lines.en: Targets by priority

lines.zh: 选择优先级较高的目标
lines.en: Higher priority targets
By target importance
Important targets first
Boom! Boom!
One turn of the winch and the stone flies.
Draw bow, fire!
Crossbow ready, fire!

lines.zh: 装填完毕，这一发算你的。
lines.en: Loaded — this shot is yours.
The stone bursts and shards fly.
The gears bite; the angle locks.
Bowstring taut, ready to fire!
Crossbow charged, fire!
Boom, boom!
Battle mode activated!
Awaiting orders, move!
Prepare for assault, move out!
Target locked, standby!
Alert, defend!
Scout enemy!
Fire support ready!
Defend home, hold ground!
Scout complete, retreat!
Orders issued, move out!

lines.zh: 火舌卷过来，我滚到车后
lines.en: Flame licks over; I roll behind the engine.

lines.zh: 我从城墙上滑下来，护膝裂了。
lines.en: I slid off the wall and cracked my knee guard.

lines.zh: 护城河的水灌进了我的工具箱。
lines.en: Moat water floods my toolbox.
A stone shell bursts and throws me down.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 法术打乱了我绞盘的刻度。
lines.en: Magic scrambles the winch's markings.

lines.zh: 装填太忙，我一天没吃东西。
lines.en: Too busy loading; I haven't eaten all day.

lines.zh: 雷电烧坏了我一根绳索。
lines.en: Lightning scorches one of my ropes.

lines.zh: 虚空把我连人带车吞了。
lines.en: The void swallows me and my engine.
